title: How the landing should work
question: The current page is a headline beside a featured card, then a stack of sections. These three throw that out. The colours, Nunito, felt, and the green button stay. Lock one.

options.label: Tonight's board
options.lineage: A tavern board of what is on tonight
options.thesis: The landing is a board of the two live games. Each game is a row you sit at, not a card beside an essay.
options.viewport: One title line, then Skull King and Ocho as two full-width rows on the felt, each with its cards and a green Play.
options.risk: A row can read as a list if the cards and the play button are small.

options.label: Two doors
options.thesis: The window is split in half. Skull King is the left felt. Ocho is the right felt. You walk into a game.
options.viewport: The GameOn bar, then two equal felt panels, each with its name, its cards, and one Play.
options.risk: A new visitor gets no sentence that says what either game is.

options.label: The season first
options.lineage: The ladder as the front door
options.thesis: The seasonal ladder is the first object, because it proves people are playing. The two games are how you join.
options.viewport: A large season board with the seven tiers, and Skull King and Ocho as the two ways onto it.
options.risk: A guest who only wants a hand tonight is shown a ladder they cannot join yet.
